interlocks.cause: Guard door open (ZS-3002 / X32 open) or E-stop chain lost (ES-0001 / X0 lost)
interlocks.effect: HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31) immediately disabled/de-energised

interlocks.cause: HiPot PASS latched (M310) or HiPot FAIL latched (M311)
interlocks.effect: HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31) de-energised

interlocks.cause: Pallet leaves ST30 (falling edge of ZS-3001 / X33)
interlocks.effect: Reset HiPot PASS (M310) and HiPot FAIL (M311) latches

steps.entry: Initial state or pallet leaves ST30 (falling edge of ZS-3001 / X33)
steps.exit: Pallet in ST30 (ZS-3001 / X33), guard door closed (ZS-3002 / X32), E-stop healthy (ES-0001 / X0), and no result latched (not M310 and not M311)
steps.name: IDLE

steps.entry: Pallet present (X33), guard closed (X32), E-stop healthy (X0), and neither PASS (M310) nor FAIL (M311) latched
steps.exit: Tester reports PASS (HP-3003 / X30), tester reports FAIL (HP-3004 / X31), guard door opens (not X32), or E-stop lost (not X0)
steps.name: TESTING (HV ENABLED)

steps.entry: Tester PASS received (X30 -> SET M310) or tester FAIL received (X31 -> SET M311)
steps.exit: Pallet leaves ST30 (falling edge of ZS-3001 / X33 resets M310 and M311)
steps.name: RESULT LATCHED (HV REMOVED)
